provenance.decoder_policy: shipped benchmark comparator path comparators._ailm_g2p_metrics -> _ailm_g2p_decode: position-wise filtering (posterior = emission row * prior, argmax, prior <- transition @ posterior), prior reset per word by build_g2p_start; not Viterbi, no backtrace
provenance.exposure_limitation: generator ownership does not certify the absence of unknown pretraining exposure; the artifact is never called contamination-free (ERRATUM-S2)
provenance.smoothing_policy: add-k Laplace: emission over the full 30x39 grid with resolved_emission_smoothing (k=1 default), transition and start with smoothing (k=1 default); unseen letter-phone pairs carry exactly the pseudocount, never zero
provenance.unseen_policy: no unseen-symbol case exists on the stipulated inventory: every letter is a row of the emission grid and every gold phone is a column, both pseudocount-backed; the uniform floor is the analytic 1/39 per position
